title: Republic of Afghanistan
capsule: The Republic of Afghanistan was established on 17 July 1973 when General Mohammad Daoud Khan overthrew King Mohammad Zahir Shah in a bloodless coup, ending 226 years of Barakzai monarchy and abolishing the 1964 constitution. Daoud ruled as president and prime minister simultaneously, initially aligning with the Soviet Union and later attempting to reduce dependence on it by cultivating ties with Iran and Egypt. The republic collapsed on 27 April 1978 when the Marxist People's Democratic Party of Afghanistan seized power in the Saur Revolution, executing Daoud and establishing the Democratic Republic of Afghanistan.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases at ~0.07° resolution. Territory corresponds precisely to the recognized Afghan state boundaries of the period; extent is unambiguous.
